params.name: headline
params.default: { DateRangePickerDefaults.DateRangePickerHeadline(selectedStartDateMillis = state.selectedStartDateMillis, selectedEndDateMillis = state.selectedEndDateMillis, displayMode = state.displayMode, dateFormatter, modifier = Modifier.padding(DateRangePickerHeadlinePadding), contentColor = colors.headlineContentColor,) }

doc.state: state of the date range picker. See [rememberDateRangePickerState].
doc.modifier: the [Modifier] to be applied to this date range picker
doc.dateFormatter: a [DatePickerFormatter] that provides formatting skeletons for dates display
doc.colors: [DatePickerColors] that will be used to resolve the colors used for this date range picker in different states. See [DatePickerDefaults.colors].
doc.title: the title to be displayed in the date range picker
doc.headline: the headline to be displayed in the date range picker
doc.showModeToggle: indicates if this DateRangePicker should show a mode toggle action that transforms it into a date range input
doc.focusRequester: a focus requester that will be used to focus the text field when the date picker is in an input mode. Pass `null` to not focus the text field if that's the desired behavior.
